discovery_notes: DLR 2015 LE/LR leads from search snippets only (30 standard WebSearch calls, blocked domains excluded). Mostly Disney Pins Blog event posts and weekly roundups plus one official Disney Parks Blog Aug release list. Reseller listings (ecrater) seen but not used as evidence. Open-edition 60th mystery/pack/framed sets left to b035. Several snippets were search-engine summaries spanning multiple results; where attribution to a URL was uncertain a hold was added.
